description: Preview, track faces and choose which faces to blur. Your videos stay on your computer.
invitation: Download FaceBlur Studio and try it on a video. We would love to hear how it works for you: share your feedback in [Issues]({issues}). If you find it useful, consider a [Star]({repo}), [Fork]({fork}) or [Watch]({repo}) to follow updates. Thank you for helping the project improve.
build_note: The macOS DMG includes all seven interface languages, system-language detection and the Arabic right-to-left workspace. The Windows installer remains version 1.1.27; the new interface features are available in the updated source and will be included in a future Windows installer.
screenshot_alt: FaceBlur Studio 1.1.23 showing face analysis and video preview
f1: Automatic face detection and tracking with YOLOv8-face.
f2: Apple Metal acceleration on macOS or DirectML on Windows, with CPU fallback.
f3: Choose which faces to blur; adjust mask size, shape, blur strength and edge feathering.
f4: Fast preview and accurate face selection in scaled video.
f5: Save and reopen `.fbp` projects with analysis results and face selections.
f6: Export MP4 with the original audio track when present.
f7: Read video frames as needed instead of keeping the whole decoded video in RAM.
f8: Process video locally without uploading it to a cloud service.
f9: Seven interface languages, automatic system-language detection and an Arabic right-to-left workspace in the updated source.
caution: Automatic detection can miss faces. Review the entire exported video before sharing it.
win_install: **Windows 10/11 x64:** run the installer and follow the English or Russian setup wizard. The default location is `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\FaceBlur Studio`; installation is per user and does not require administrator rights. Python, FFmpeg, the model and inference libraries are bundled. Uninstall through Windows Settings; user projects and settings are preserved.
win_limits: The Windows installer is unsigned. Installation, reinstallation, packaged startup and uninstallation were verified on the development Windows 11 machine; a separate clean Windows/VM has not yet been tested. See [installer details]({win_details}) and [Windows verification results]({win_validation}).
mac_install: **Apple Silicon Mac:** open the DMG and drag **FaceBlur Studio** to **Applications**. Python, FFmpeg and the face detection model are bundled and need no separate installation.
mac_limits: This preliminary DMG uses a local ad hoc signature and is **not notarized** by Apple. macOS may block its first launch. If you trust the download, follow [Apple's Open Anyway instructions]({apple_help}) in System Settings → Privacy & Security. A separate clean Mac has not been tested. This image targets Apple Silicon; it does not support Intel Macs or Windows.
source_intro: Python 3.12 and FFmpeg are required. The macOS model `yolov8s-face.pt` and Windows model `yolov8s-face.onnx` are included. On macOS, install FFmpeg with `brew install ffmpeg`, then run:
win_source: On Windows, use PowerShell, Python 3.12 and FFmpeg on PATH. Activate with `.\venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1` and install `requirements-windows.txt` instead of `requirements.txt`. See the [Windows port guide]({win_handoff}) and [installer build instructions]({win_details}). The [DMG build script]({dmg_script}) requires `create-dmg`.
step1: Open a video and click **Find faces**.
step2: Select faces in the gallery, adjust the mask and review the preview.
step3: Save an `.fbp` project to continue later, or export an MP4.
language_behavior: On first launch, the updated app uses your system's preferred supported UI language, falling back to English. In **Settings → Interface language**, choose **Automatic — system language** or a specific language. Your choice is saved and applies immediately without closing the project. Supported languages: English, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Arabic, Serbian (Cyrillic), Greek and Spanish.
rtl_behavior: Arabic uses right-to-left text and a mirrored inspector/action layout. Video pixels, face coordinates, filenames, numbers and playback timelines keep their original meaning and direction.
log_warning: Open the log folder from **About → Open log folder**. Logs may contain local paths; review them before sharing.
contents: The repository includes source code, detection models, the [app icon]({icon}), [banner]({banner}) and screenshot. Installers are attached to [Windows release v1.1.27]({win_release}) and [macOS release v1.1.28]({mac_release}), not committed to the source tree.
support: Report bugs, share feedback or suggest improvements in [GitHub Issues]({issues}). Include the app version, operating system, steps to reproduce and expected result. Attach a reviewed log if useful, but keep private videos out of public reports. Translation corrections are welcome.
maintainer: Maintained by [@sirdimitry]({maintainer}). To contribute, open an issue describing the change, then submit a pull request with a brief explanation and validation results. Update every language version when changing the README; see [localization workflow]({localization}).
license: No separate license file has been published yet. Reuse terms for the source code and bundled models need to be clarified before redistribution or modification.
